name: Arsenal
creator: ROLVe
redeem: Launch Arsenal on Roblox and stay on the main menu screen.
Click the gift box icon in the bottom left corner.
Type the code into the text box exactly as shown.
Press Redeem. Skins, taunts and announcer voices go straight to your inventory.
notes:
Arsenal is a fast first-person shooter from ROLVe. In the main Gun Game mode, every kill swaps your weapon for the next one in a set list, and the first player to get a kill with the final weapon, the Golden Knife, wins the round. Matches run through everything from rifles and shotguns to bazookas and spell books, and you earn BattleBucks as you play to spend on skins, melees, kill effects and announcer voices.

Arsenal codes almost never give BattleBucks. Instead they unlock cosmetics like skins, announcer voices and taunts, many tied to YouTubers and community members, and some older codes only show a message or teleport you to a map. GARCELLO is the best pick since it bundles a skin, a kill effect and a taunt. ROLVe drops new codes with seasonal events and updates, and posts them on X and Discord.

codes.reward: Garcello skin, kill effect and taunt

faq.a: Rarely. Almost every working code unlocks a cosmetic such as a skin, taunt or announcer voice, so BattleBucks mostly come from playing matches.

faq.q: Where is the codes button in Arsenal?
faq.a: It is the gift box icon in the bottom left of the main menu. Redeem your codes from the menu screen before you jump into a round.

faq.q: Why do Arsenal code lists online disagree so much?
faq.a: Arsenal has hundreds of old codes, and ROLVe switches them off without warning. Sites that do not retest keep listing dead ones, so expect older codes like KITTEN or JOHN to fail.

tips: Join the ROLVe group, as the game page suggests. Members get 25% more BattleBucks and XP from every match, plus a chat tag.
When your weapon changes, take a second to check what you are holding. A sniper and a shotgun want very different spots, so move to fit the new gun.
Each new weapon comes with a full magazine, so a kill is often a better reload than stopping in the open to reload.
Keep moving and use cover. Matches are fast, and players who stand still in open areas are the easiest targets.
useRewards: Every working code unlocks a cosmetic, so redeem them all to fill out your collection at no cost. Equip the Garcello skin, kill effect and taunt together for a matching look, and try the Flamingo, Xonae, Enforcer and Bandites announcer voices to pick the one you like. None of these rewards change your weapons or stats, so you can redeem them any time without affecting your matches.
